purpose: Install passive Oracle controls without enabling or executing cloud experimentation.

github.name: TCC_ORACLE_BLINDING_KEY_B64
github.value_policy: generate cryptographically random value at installation; never persist in repository or command output

github.name: TCC_ORACLE_ARCHIVE_PASSPHRASE
github.value_policy: generate cryptographically random value at installation; never persist in repository or command output

expected_readiness_after_installation.remaining_candidate_blocker: open same-repository non-draft disarmed pull request

cost_scope.note: The proposed Kubernetes RBAC and GitHub control objects do not provision a billable GCP workload. The existing running cluster remains outside this change set and may continue to incur cost.

explicitly_excluded: terraform apply before renewed plan validation and explicit user authorization
attaching any cloud-authorization label to a pull request
creating staging, PDT, controller, or Oracle workloads
enabling or querying Cloud Billing export
authorizing experiment cost or confirmatory collection
pre_apply_requirements: obtain explicit user authorization for this exact change set
regenerate the Terraform plan with current remote state
require the Oracle RBAC validator to pass 10/10
require exactly two creates, zero changes, and zero destroys
confirm the Oracle namespace contains no active workload
keep all cloud execution and publication switches disabled
post_apply_requirements: run the Oracle readiness auditor in read-only mode
require 18/21 infrastructure checks and 0/1 candidate checks
verify the Oracle namespace still contains no active workload
record a mutation receipt without secret values
